responsibility: Defines the common command-line options and target variables for the Xtensa backend. It introduces machine switches controlling constant loading, PIC suppression, long calls, extra L32R cost modeling, LRA use, branch-target alignment, text-section literals, automatic literal pools, volatile serialization, and ABI selection, and binds them to target masks or variables such as xtensa_windowed_abi that are consumed by xtensa.cc, xtensa.h, and the assembler/linker specs.
same_name_distinction: Among the xtensa.* files, this is the option-definition file: it declares the Xtensa machine switches and target variables such as mlongcalls, mauto-litpools, and mabi=*, which are then consumed by xtensa.cc/xtensa.h and assembler/linker specs, rather than implementing hooks, macros, or RTL patterns itself.
